shortDescription: Recruiting firm SThree LSE:STEM raised its full-year pretax profit forecast on Tuesday, citing cost cuts undertaken by the company.SThree now expects pretax profit of around £12 million ($16.05 million), up from an earlier forecast of around £10 million.($1 = £0.7474)
